exercises.title: Running total per seller
exercises.problemHtml:
For every sale return seller, sold_on, amount, running_total — the seller's cumulative sales up to and including that day. Order by seller, sold_on.

Sample table (chapter 8)

sale (id PK, region, seller, amount numeric(10,2), sold_on date) — the 8 rows of lesson 8.1
 1 North Alice 100 2026-01-05 · 2 North Alice 150 2026-02-10 · 3 North Bob 200 2026-01-20 · 4 North Bob 150 2026-03-01
 5 South Carol 300 2026-01-15 · 6 South Carol 250 2026-02-20 · 7 South Dave 180 2026-02-05 · 8 South Dave 220 2026-03-10

Requirements

  • An ORDER BY inside OVER turns sum() into a running sum.
  • Restart for each seller: PARTITION BY seller.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Với mọi giao dịch trả về seller, sold_on, amount, running_total — doanh số cộng dồn của người bán tới hết ngày đó. Sắp theo seller, sold_on.

Yêu cầu

  • ORDER BY bên trong OVER biến sum() thành tổng cộng dồn.
  • Bắt đầu lại cho mỗi người bán: PARTITION BY seller.

exercises.problemHtml:
For every day of September 2026 that had at least one payment return day, payments, revenue, month_to_date, change: number of payments, revenue of the day, cumulative revenue since 1 September, and the difference with the previous paying day (NULL on the first). Order by day.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)

WITH d AS (
  SELECT paid_at::date AS day, count(*) AS payments, sum(amount) AS revenue
  FROM payment
  WHERE paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND paid_at < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT day, payments, revenue,
       sum(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY day)            AS month_to_date,
       revenue - lag(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY day)  AS change
FROM d
ORDER BY day;

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);
